title: fill_navigation
description: FILL_INTENT decoder contract for the 'navigation' family (R58 verdict §2). Emitted only after SELECT_INTENT has already committed to 'navigation' — this becomes the single-item allowlist schema for that turn. Every spatial field is an observation-store HANDLE (harness-owned object reference), never a literal grid, mask, or pixel coordinate — the model supplies semantics (which region is the mover, which cell is the goal), the harness resolves handles and runs the kernel.

mover.description: The tracked region the plan will displace.

goals.description: Candidate goal cells, tried in order; the first reachable one is planned.

passable_mask.description: Handle to the caller-declared passability grid (harness-owned, never printed inline).

action_map.description: Handle to the measured (row,col)-delta -> action-id map used to turn the path into moves.

goal_hypothesis.description: Which win-condition-typology goal candidate this plan is trying to satisfy (kept separate from the mechanic intent per verdict §4).

support.description: At least one evidence handle grounding mover/passability, per verdict §6 (appearance-only evidence cannot activate a family).

falsifier.description: Which playbook falsifier name (strong or weak) this specific commitment is staked on.
